question: How did Nebius do in the second quarter of 2026?
memo: Nebius reported strong top-line growth with continued losses in the quarter. Revenues were $582.3m for the three months ended June 30, 2026. Adjusted EBITDA was $236.2m for the three months ended June 30, 2026. Net loss from continuing operations was $190.4m for the three months ended June 30, 2026. Total operating costs and expenses were $758.2m for the three months ended June 30, 2026.
